QuestInfo.name: [Hayato] Adaptation 3
QuestInfo.0: You're beginning to adjust to this new world, but it'll still be a while before you're back at full strength.
QuestInfo.1: Go back to the training grounds and defeat some more dummies.
QuestInfo.2: Your strength has improved with every battle. Hopefully it will be enough for the challenges ahead.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 710\nCan proceed to the Dark Times quest

0.0: I was hoping you would have higher standards for yourself. Weren't you named the Bladed Falcon? Such a moniker is undeserved, from what I have seen. Nonetheless, let us continue.

yes.0: Take down 30 of the Conjureyes stationed in Training Dojo 3. They will be much stronger. Perhaps you can join them, if you prove yourself!
I suppose you're proud of yourself, having turned my training dummies into horse feed. You understand, I hope, that I don't have the resources to continue your journey of self-improvement.
yes.1: Take time to prepare for the battles ahead. The enemies will be fighting back this time.

default.0: Are the Conjureyes in Training Dojo 3 too strong for you? I should not be surprised...
